1.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 1. App background tint.

2.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 2. Subtle background: code blocks, table stripes.

3.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 3. Tinted fill: badges, selected rows.

4.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 4. Tinted fill, hover.

5.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 5. Tinted fill, pressed.

6.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 6. Subtle teal border.

7.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 7. Teal border, dividers on tinted areas.

8.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 8. Strong teal border, hover outlines.

9.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 9. Solid teal; focus ring.

10.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 10. THE brand teal: solid fills, primary buttons, logo dots in light mode. Graphics only on white (4.4:1): use teal-11 for body-size text.

11.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 11. Teal text and links (5.5:1 on white in light; 9.5:1 on the dark ground). Logo dots in dark mode.

12.$description: Bedrock.engineer teal scale, step 12. Darkest teal text, headings on teal-3.

surface.$description: Cards, panels, the hero. Sits on bg.

ink.$description: Body text, titles and the logo letters, on bg or surface (15:1+ in both themes).

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text: ledes, captions, nav (5.9:1 light, 9:1 dark on bg).

line.$description: Hairline borders on cards and section rules. The system uses borders, not shadows.

guide.$description: Construction lines in technical drawings: baseline, x-height, dimensions.

grid-cell.$description: Drawing-paper grid and grid-texture lines behind the drawing.

logo-dot.$description: The teal dots of the logo: j, period and i. Lighter in dark mode so they stay visible.

texture.$description: Stroke color of background textures, used at 16–22% opacity.

teal.$description: Categorical color for lines, bars and points. First series, and the only one when a chart has one series. Lighter in dark mode so it stays visible.

plum.$description: Categorical color for lines, bars and points. Second series. Lighter in dark mode so it stays visible.

indigo.$description: Categorical color for lines, bars and points. Third series. Lighter in dark mode so it stays visible.

violet.$description: Categorical color for lines, bars and points. Fourth series. Lighter in dark mode so it stays visible.

gray.$description: Categorical color for lines, bars and points. 'Other', or a fifth series. More than five categories: use another palette. Lighter in dark mode so it stays visible.
